The deposits were $9,576.59, $9,530.63, $9,274.89, and $9,154.34 at various branches. This pattern suggests an attempt to evade currency transaction reporting requirements (31 USC 5324). The activity is inconsistent with her profile as a therapist, indicating potential illicit activity. This report is filed in compliance with 31 CFR 1020.320 and FinCEN SAR Instructions.
